EmailTemplate.description: Email for students who are in individual review.
EmailTemplate.name: Individual Review (70s list - eval status WT)
EmailTemplate.subject: Your application is being reviewed
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for applying to Arizona State University. Your application is complete and is currently in individual review.
Students who do not meet admission standards receive a more holistic review of their applications to ensure their success at Arizona State University. During this process, Admission Services will review all available information about your application, carefully considering all aspects of your academic background and accomplishments. Submission of an ACT or SAT score is highly recommended. In some cases, additional information will be requested.
We thank you for your patience. You will have an admission decision by the end of ASU’s current semester. If you have any questions, please contact your personal admission representative at https://asu.edu/findmyrep.
Sincerely,
Admission Services https://asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
